Article 6.2: Exhibition Account Resets

Warren's summary

Summarize this rule

If you fail your Exhibition account, you have two options within 7 trading days of the failure:

Option 1: Reset the Exhibition Account

Pay the Exhibition reset fee to restart your Exhibition account without going back to evaluation. You must choose this within 7 trading days of the breach.

Account Size	Exhibition Reset Fee
$25,000	$312.50
$50,000	$625.00
$100,000	$1,250.00
$150,000	$1,875.00
$250,000	$3,125.00
Option 2: Restart the Evaluation

Purchase a new evaluation account and start the evaluation process from the beginning. This is the lower-cost option if the Exhibition reset fee is too high.

7-DAY WINDOW TO RESET EXHIBITION After failing your Exhibition account, you have exactly 7 TRADING DAYS to submit the reset fee. After 7 trading days, the reset option expires. You must restart the evaluation. This 7-day window applies to BOTH Standard OG and Express OG Exhibition accounts.
